pr.title: Add ConPort and dope-memory read adapters to DCP readonly facade
pr.body:
Add project-scoped ConPort and dope-memory read adapters with strict route allowlists, denylist tests, redaction, pagination, and canonical response envelopes.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

steps.task: Implement per objective: Add project-scoped ConPort and dope-memory read adapters with strict route allowlists, denylist tests, redaction, pagination, and canonical response envelopes. In-scope work: Implement ConPort read adapter for GET /api/decisions, GET /api/progress, GET /api/search/{workspace_id}. Implement dope-memory read adapter for /tools/memory_search and /tools/memory_replay_session. Add tools search_decisions, search_progress, search_chronicle, replay_chronicle_session. Add backend route manifest and tests. Add mocked backend tests and optional live tests behind explicit env flag.
requirements: Implement ConPort read adapter for GET /api/decisions, GET /api/progress, GET /api/search/{workspace_id}.
Implement dope-memory read adapter for /tools/memory_search and /tools/memory_replay_session.
Add tools search_decisions, search_progress, search_chronicle, replay_chronicle_session.
Add backend route manifest and tests.
Add mocked backend tests and optional live tests behind explicit env flag.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff.
validation: ConPort GET decisions/progress/search allowed only through registry-bound service profile.
dope-memory search/replay accepted only through explicit read exceptions.
No bridge URL appears in adapter code except denylist tests/docs.

steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0005/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDIT.md) and run the embedded audit.
requirements: AUDIT.md challenging POST read exception and route allowlist.
validation: Proof bundle present with command outputs and exit codes.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).
